Package com.handshakr.handshakr_prototype.handshake

Class HandshakeServiceImpl

java.lang.Object
com.handshakr.handshakr_prototype.handshake.HandshakeServiceImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
HandshakeService
@Service public class HandshakeServiceImpl extends Object implements HandshakeService
Implementation of the HandshakeService interface. Provides methods to create, update, and retrieve handshakes, and handles the business logic of handshakes.
